Maya (CS Ops): Heads-up — planning a targeted CRM sweep to normalize onboarding_status and health_score buckets. Thinking Wed 10pm PT for the run. Want a quick alignment thread.
Sam H: Scope? which fields exactly and are we touching ownership fields?
Maya (CS Ops): Fields: onboarding_status (not_started, in_progress, completed), last_activity (date), health_score_bucket (low/med/high), onboarding_owner (csm_id). Not touching opportunity/contract fields.
Jordan C: Please don't overwrite any manual "high_risk" flags we've set for renewal. We rely on those for alerts.
Maya (CS Ops): Yep — plan is to respect opt-outs. Proposed rule: skip records with tag `no_auto_update` or `manual_risk_flagged=true`.
Carla (Data): I can run a dry-run export from HubSpot and produce a CSV with before/after diff. SQL-ish export we'll use for staging: 
```sql
SELECT id, email, onboarding_status, last_activity, health_score FROM contacts WHERE lifecycle_stage='customer';
```
Will include change_reason column in the diff.
Lisa (CSM): How will CSMs be notified of changes to their accounts? We need a changelog so we can review before the weekly sync.
Maya (CS Ops): Plan: 1) Dry-run Mon 9am PT — output to #cs-diffs and upload CSV to /shared/cs/exports. 2) Review window Tue afternoon. 3) Production swap Wed 10pm PT with 4h rollback window. We'll also push a per-CSM digest listing changed accounts.
Sam H: What's the automation path? HubSpot workflows or direct API patch? Any rate limits?
Carla (Data): We'll use the HubSpot API for patches via our `crm-sync` job. Throttle = 10 req/s, backoff on 429. We'll add idempotency keys.
Maya (CS Ops): I'll create the runbook and a checklist. Key checks: backup snapshot (ops-bot will run), dry-run CSV sanity, opt-out list present, and slas for rollback.
ops-bot: Automated snapshot scheduled: HubSpot export snapshot saved to /backups/hubspot/1765432100.zip — created by ops-bot.
Jordan C: Thanks. Please add a column in the CSV indicating whether the change affects renewal risk. I can triage that list.
Carla (Data): Will include `affects_renewal_risk` boolean based on health_score delta > 1 bucket or onboarding_status regressed.
Sam H: One more ask — can we tag records we changed with `cs_auto_sweep_v1` so we can filter later?
Maya (CS Ops): Yes — add `cs_auto_sweep_v1` and `cs_auto_sweep_ts`. We'll exclude any contact with `no_auto_update`.
Lisa (CSM): Please ping me when dry-run is uploaded. I'll do a quick pass for my book.
Maya (CS Ops): Will do. I'll create a Notion playbook and a calendar invite for Tue review. Thanks everyone — I'll post the ticket and run details in here once created.
